machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Ticket `fwrd75-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (reference **RD-1015**, customer "Bench Customer Ltd", raised 2026-09-17). It appeared in the ticket list after the refresh beat and its detail page is at `/#/tickets/t15`.

**2. DONE** — Part `fwrd75-n1 RD Part A` added with cost 100, markup 25%. The app computed and displayed a price of **$125.00** (row: `fwrd75-n1 RD Part A | $100.00 | 25% | 1 | No supplier | $125.00`).

**3. DONE** — Part `fwrd75-n1 RD Part B` added with cost 200, markup 25%. The app computed and displayed a price of **$250.00** (row: `fwrd75-n1 RD Part B | $200.00 | 25% | 1 | No supplier | $250.00`). Parts total at that point: $375.00.

**4. DONE** — Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup kept at 25). The app now computes **$187.50** for Part A (row: `fwrd75-n1 RD Part A | $150.00 | 25% | 1 | No supplier | $187.50`); parts total became $437.50.

**5. DONE** — Ticket status is **Ready**. The precondition the app enforces: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier**. The first "Mark Ready" attempt was rejected with the app's alert: *"Ticket is not ready — Part "fwrd75-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier — Part "fwrd75-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"* (the part form allows saving with a blank supplier, so both parts had "No supplier"). I satisfied it by editing each part and setting Supplier = "Bench Supplier Co" on both, then "Mark Ready" succeeded — the status field reads "Ready" and the buttons changed to "Mark Draft"/"Mark Closed".

**6. DONE** — Both parts deleted (each via the part's Delete button, confirmed in the app's in-page "Confirm" dialog with "Delete part"). After the refresh, the parts table shows only **"No parts on this ticket yet."** — neither part remains. The ticket was then archived via the "Archive ticket" button on the detail page (no confirmation dialog); the button flipped to "Unarchive ticket" and an "Archived" badge appeared beside the title. Verified on the list: with "Show archived" checked, the row reads `RD-1015 | fwrd75-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Bench Customer Ltd | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-17`; with "Show archived" unchecked, searching RD-1015 returns "No tickets match the current filters." — nothing created by this run is left active.
